sources.role: The pinned 2.5.5 legacy Dart cache is changed before platform write; reload obtains the platform snapshot, not an independent disk acknowledgement.
Official Android 2.4.28 tag resolves to 9854cd56. Legacy setString returns synchronous SharedPreferences.Editor.commit; getAll reads the native preferences map.

Android15 commit applies commitToMemory before disk write and returns writeToDiskResult. getAll copies mMap; a failed disk return does not make that native snapshot a positive commit. writeToFile retains the distinction between memory and disk generations.

conclusion: A platform snapshot equal to an attempted write is insufficient to positively acknowledge it. The proposal requires a true reply from a same-value platform commit before exposing a recovered/restored state or deduplicated award.
limits: Source-derived conditional failure, not a claimed observed data loss in 7ac.
No Android disk-failure experiment, APK install, crash/power-loss proof or universal OS-version assertion was performed.
Native Memory consumes the authoritative Dart acknowledgement; it has no independent second SharedPreferences commit barrier.
